industries.quote: the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) adopted new rules
industries.scope_quote: the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) adopted new rules and interpretations aimed at enhancing protections for retail investors while preserving their choice and access to investment services
industries.mechanism: The new rules and interpretations affect the entire industry of security and commodity brokers, dealers, exchanges, and services by setting standards for broker-dealers and investment advisers, requiring them to act in the best interest of retail investors and disclose conflicts of interest.
industries.industry_name_standard: SECURITY & COMMODITY BROKERS, DEALERS, EXCHANGES & SERVICES

industries.quote: broker-dealers to act in the best interest of retail customers
industries.scope_quote: broker-dealers to act in the best interest of retail customers when making recommendations
industries.mechanism: The rules require all broker-dealers within the industry to adhere to a standard of conduct that prioritizes the best interest of retail investors, affecting the entire sector of security brokers, dealers, and flotation companies.

industries.quote: investment advisers and the 'solely incidental' prong of the broker-dealer exclusion
industries.scope_quote: the fiduciary duty of investment advisers and the 'solely incidental' prong of the broker-dealer exclusion under the Advisers Act
industries.mechanism: The rules affect the entire industry of investment advice by clarifying the fiduciary duty and the broker-dealer exclusion, impacting how investment advisers operate and interact with retail investors.
